statement: The report explicitly contains no figures on GPU or AI-server lead times, TSMC CoWoS capacity constraints, or foundry allocation policies for NVIDIA, AMD and Intel AI chips this cycle.
why: Knowing that a weekly industry roundup carried no lead-time or packaging-allocation data means the supply-tightness picture for this week rests on other sources, and the gap should not be read as easing.

impact.mechanism: Absence of lead-time and CoWoS allocation data in the week's roundup leaves the packaging-constraint read unrefreshed, so prior tightness assumptions carry forward unverified.

evidence.excerpt: it contains no specific figures on GPU/AI-server lead times, TSMC CoWoS capacity constraints, or foundry allocation policies for NVIDIA/AMD/Intel AI chips this cycle.

confidence.basis: This is an absence of data in one aggregator, not a measurement; it carries no information about the direction of actual lead times.
